before: A character with the emoji variation selector took the run face's text glyph when that face mapped the character.
after: A character above Latin-1 with U+FE0F, a keycap, and a joined emoji sequence take a color face, and an editor that loads fonts on demand loads the emoji step once.
reason: Only glyph selection, font loading, and line measurement change. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged.
